mcp-score.description: mcp-score Python MCP server (official: https://github.com/tskovlund/mcp-score). Installed from source into project .venv. Uses music21; does not require MuseScore plugin.

github.description: GitHub official MCP server (github/github-mcp-server v1.9.0). Read-only mode; token supplied via ZCode client environment.

playwright.description: Microsoft Playwright MCP for browser automation. Package verified on npm: @playwright/mcp. Requires local browser install.

zai-mcp-server.description: Z.ai MCP server. Requires ZAI_API_KEY environment variable.

web-search.description: Web search MCP. Package verified on npm: web-search. Requires WEB_SEARCH_API_KEY environment variable.

web-reader.description: Web reader MCP. Package verified on npm: web-reader. Requires WEB_READER_API_KEY environment variable.

mcp-musescore.description: Community MuseScore MCP. Disabled by default; MuseScore CLI is already available.

dorico-mcp-server.description: Dorico MCP server. Disabled by default; requires Dorico license.

OMR_LEGACY_COMPARE.note: Controlled A/B comparison profile (2026-08-23). orchestral-score-rebuild resolves natively from .agents/skills/orchestral-score-rebuild/SKILL.md (legacy Codex skill, reference-only). Not a production default; superseded by OMR_FULL for production routing.

OMR_FULL.note: Candidate production score pipeline (2026-08-23). Stage routing: source PDF -> score-reconstruction-v2 (PRIMARY_RECONSTRUCTION) -> musicxml-qa (CORE_QA) -> orchestral-score-rebuild (POST_RECONSTRUCTION_REFERENCE_VERIFICATION_AND_REPAIR; must NOT rerun completed full OMR) -> musicxml-qa -> score-export (DELIVERY, only after QA pass). Existing OMR profile objects are preserved.

OMR_BENCHMARK.note: BENCHMARK_ONLY (2026-08-23). Not listed in enabled_profiles; only toggled on for explicit provider benchmarks / A/B / regression tasks. Never auto-invoked in ordinary production jobs.

DEV_SAFE.note: Daily code-development gates (2026-08-23). Routed by trigger, never all three automatically: bug/regression -> systematic-debugging; new implementation/repair rule -> test-driven-development; task completion -> verification-before-completion.

DEV_COMPLEX.note: Complex multi-stage development only (2026-08-23): multi-file changes, architecture migration, major features, risky refactors. Simple single-file fixes do not route here.

SCORE_REBUILD.note: Optional ZCode compatibility profile for the agent-neutral V0.1 entry point. Enables exactly one user-facing Skill; all internal/development profiles require explicit selection.
